E000.desc: It has almost no offensive capabilities, but possesses seemingly infinite durability.
E000.name: Shadow Man

E001.desc: Small demi-humans that live in groups in caves and abandoned villages. They have low intelligence and are weak, but are cunning and like to set traps and ambush their prey.
E001.name: Goblin

E002.desc: A gentle magical beast that lives in herds on grasslands. Normally it only eats grass, but when it senses danger, it imbues its fur with magic and emits an electric shock.
E002.name: Merry

E003.desc: A gigantic, ferocious bee. It builds its nests in forests and flower fields and is extremely territorial. Even adventurers can be in danger when attacked by a swarm.
E003.name: Killer Bee

E004.desc: A large bat that inhabits dark caves and ruins. It uses sound waves to probe its surroundings and confuse prey. It is generally timid, but becomes ferocious when hungry.
E004.name: Large bat

E005.desc: A giant, magically-powered frog that lives in wetlands. It catches prey by extending its tongue, and some individuals can also squirt poisonous mucus.
E005.name: Frog

E006.desc: Giant rats that inhabit urban sewers and ruins in large numbers. They have a high reproductive rate and live in groups. They are aggressive and often carry pathogens.
E006.name: Giant Rat

E007.desc: A semi-liquid creature that appears in swamps and caves. It looks harmless at first glance, but it envelops its prey in a slime that dissolves it. Physical attacks are ineffective against it.
E007.name: Slime

E008.desc: A giant spider that spins its web underground. It has a habit of ambushing its prey, immobilizing them with silk before killing them with its venomous fangs.
E008.name: Tsuchigumo (a type of spider)

E009.desc: A brutal beast-man that lives in forests and mountains. They are strong and live in settlements. They are warlike and will attack anyone they see who is weaker.
E009.name: Oak

E010.desc: A skeletal soldier powered by magic. It appears in cemeteries and ruins and faithfully follows orders. It has no emotions and feels no pain.
E010.name: Skeleton

E011.desc: A monstrous mushroom that grows in clusters in damp forests and caves. They are loosely connected to each other by spores, and when they sense danger, they scatter poisonous spores.
E011.name: Mash

E012.desc: Animals that live in herds in forests and mountainous areas. They possess high intelligence and teamwork, and hunt down prey under the command of their leader.
E012.name: Wolf

E013.desc: A giant turtle that inhabits wetlands and lakeshores. Its thick shell protects it from most attacks, and although it moves slowly, it shows no mercy to anyone who enters its territory.
E013.name: Tortoise

E014.desc: Spiritual beings that drift through cemeteries and ancient ruins. They have little emotion and simply wander aimlessly, but they have a tendency to be drawn to strong magical powers.
E014.name: Spirit

E015.desc: A being resurrected as a warrior, possessing the resentment left behind on the battlefield, which resides in his bones. He retains some of his combat skills from his life, and wields rusty swords and shields with skill.
E015.name: Skull Fighter

E016.desc: A carnivorous fish that lives in schools in tropical rivers and lakes. It moves at incredible speeds underwater and has a keen sense for the smell of blood. It attacks its prey in groups, biting and tearing off flesh in an instant.
E016.name: Piranha

E017.desc: A dog made from a corpse resurrected by magic or a curse. Despite its decaying body, it is agile and its ferocity has increased. Attacking in a pack is extremely dangerous.
E017.name: Zombie Dog

E018.desc: Human outlaws lurking in the wilderness and along the roads. They attack travelers for their money and valuables, but their combat ability varies greatly from person to person. They also possess a cowardly side, running away at the slightest sign of danger.
E018.name: Thief

E019.desc: A large snake that inhabits grasslands and wetlands. It lies silently in ambush of its prey and injects venom with a swift bite. It is sensitive to temperature changes and becomes sluggish at night.
E019.name: Snake

E020.desc: A lawless pirate who terrorizes the seas. Skilled in shipboard combat, he wields axes and firearms. He is brutal and greedy, but has a strong sense of camaraderie.
E020.name: Pirates

E021.desc: Small beastmen who live in mines and caves. They are skillful and good at making tools, so they often use traps and makeshift weapons. They suddenly become very aggressive when acting in groups.
E021.name: Kobold

E022.desc: A gigantic, bewitching flower that blooms in wetlands and dense jungles. It lures prey with its sweet scent and showers anyone who gets too close with poisonous pollen. A troublesome presence that dominates the surrounding ecosystem.
E022.name: Rafflesia

E023.desc: A being imbued with the vengeful spirit of a soldier who lost his life in war. It retains some of its combat skills from its lifetime and fights in a steady manner using a shield and sword.
E023.name: Soldier

E024.desc: Demons and magical creatures possessed by magic. They are highly intelligent and can fire magic projectiles and status-altering spells from long distances.
E024.name: Magician

E025.desc: These are moving corpses that appear in cemeteries and battlefields. They are slow-moving due to decay but are unusually resilient. They become a greater threat when they appear in groups.
E025.name: Zombie

E026.desc: A giant crab that inhabits coastlines and shallow waters. It repels physical attacks with its hard carapace and pinches its prey with its sharp claws. It is highly territorial and shows no mercy to those who approach.
E026.name: Club

E027.desc: A giant beast-man that inhabits mountains and wildernesses. It is particularly strong and durable. Although its intelligence is low, its charge when it is enraged possesses tremendous destructive power.
E027.name: Ogre

E028.desc: A giant frog resurrected by a curse. It oozes poisonous mucus from its decaying body, spreading pathogens, making close combat extremely dangerous.
E028.name: Evil Frog

E029.desc: A giant starfish-shaped monster lurking in the depths of the ocean. It possesses an inexhaustible life force that allows it to regenerate unless its core is destroyed. It sucks on its prey with its tentacle-like arms, absorbing their energy.
E029.name: Evil Star

E030.desc: A large magical beast that lives in herds on grasslands. It is generally docile, but will retaliate with a charge against anyone who enters its territory. Its charge is tremendous, powerful enough to shake the ground.
E030.name: Buffalo

E031.desc: A humanoid assassin monster that lives hidden in the shadows. It lurks in forests and abandoned temples, possessing the ability to completely erase its presence. Its personality is ruthless and it is loyal to its mission.
E031.name: Ninja

E032.desc: A reptilian demi-human that lives in wetlands and riverbanks. They form settlements and possess their own unique warrior culture. They are cold-blooded and their emotions are difficult to read, but they show no mercy to those who invade their territory.
E032.name: Lizardman

E033.desc: A giant bird of prey that inhabits mountainous regions. It has keen eyesight to spot prey from afar, then swoops down and kills it with its sharp talons. It has a proud temperament and a strong territorial instinct.
E033.name: Eagle

E034.desc: An intelligent slime that appears in areas with high magical energy. It possesses a brain-like organ and has strong mental manipulation abilities. It is cunning and disrupts the thoughts of its prey to cause confusion.
E034.name: Brain

E035.desc: An embodiment of death that appears in cemeteries and cursed lands. It has little physical form, and a single scythe strike can erode the very soul. It has no emotions, and is simply a being that brings death.
E035.name: Shinigami

E036.desc: A giant fish that inhabits the deep sea and lakes with strong magical energy. Its scales are as hard as a dragon's, and some individuals can spit high-pressure water jets or small sparks from their mouths.
E036.name: Dragonfish

E037.desc: A giant octopus that lurks in underwater caves. It possesses high intelligence and lies in wait for its prey, hiding in the shadows of rocks. It entangles its victims with suction cups and immobilizes them with a powerful grip.
E037.name: Octopus

E038.desc: A giant crocodile that inhabits wetlands and riverbanks. It moves at incredible speeds in water and is quick on land over short distances. It has a ferocious temperament.
E038.name: Crocodile

E039.desc: A giant made of wood, born as the guardian of an ancient forest. It moves using magic and has almost no emotions, but it has a strong instinct to protect the forest.
E039.name: Wood Golem

E040.desc: A singing monster that appears on the sea. It lures sailors into the ocean with its beautiful songs. It has a capricious personality and only targets those that pique its interest.
E040.name: Siren

E041.desc: Stone statue monsters that lurk in ancient ruins and castle roofs. They are completely petrified and immobile during the day, but become active at night using magic.
E041.name: Gargoyle

E042.desc: A giant bear that inhabits deep forests. It is usually gentle, but shows fierce anger towards anyone who enters its territory. It becomes especially ferocious before hibernation.
E042.name: Grizzly

E043.desc: A giant insect-like monster that moves by swimming through the desert earth. It is sensitive to vibrations and attacks anyone walking on the surface, recognizing them as prey.
E043.name: Worm

E044.desc: A mystical beast that lives in the sacred forest. It only reveals itself to those with pure hearts and possesses the power to heal the wounded. Its character is noble and proud.
E044.name: Unicorn

E045.desc: A giant tree born as a guardian of an ancient forest. It moves slowly, but when angered, it possesses the power to shake the earth.
E045.name: Torrent

E046.desc: A type of slime, a jelly-like organism with superior flexibility and jumping ability. Its properties vary depending on its color, and some individuals possess attributes such as acidity, electricity, or cold.
E046.name: Jerry

E047.desc: A hybrid creature of a lion and an eagle that makes its nest in mountainous regions. Proud and merciless to those who enter its territory. Some individuals can even control the wind.
E047.name: Griffin

E048.desc: A cursed tiger-man who transforms on the night of the full moon. He usually maintains his rationality, but when transformed he becomes ferocious and brutal. He is characterized by his swift movements and rapid attacks with his sharp claws.
E048.name: War Tiger

E049.desc: A cursed demon with snake-like hair. They live in caves and ruined temples, hunting intruders with their petrifying gaze. They are solitary and vengeful.
E049.name: Medusa

E050.desc: A guardian of a giant rock, moved by magic. It has no emotions and silently guards the area it is commanded to protect. It is extremely resistant to physical attacks.
E050.name: Stone Golem

E051.desc: A mounted magic-armored soldier. It appears in wastelands and ancient battlefields, charging forward with lightning speed. Its personality is cold and ruthless, and it is loyal to its orders.
E051.name: Horse Knight

E052.desc: A lion-like magical beast that reigns supreme over the grasslands. The individual at the top of the pack is particularly strong, intimidating surrounding enemies with its roar. It has a proud temperament and rarely targets the weak.
E052.name: Leo

E053.desc: A giant with a bull's head that inhabits labyrinths and underground ruins. It possesses immense strength and durability, and will charge through even narrow passages. It has a brutal temperament and becomes enraged when it finds an intruder.
E053.name: Minotaur

E054.desc: A multi-headed dragon that lurks in swamps and lakes. It possesses the vitality to regenerate even if its head is cut off. It has a ferocious temperament and mercilessly attacks anyone who enters its territory.
E054.name: Hydra

E055.desc: A gigantic sea monster lurking in the deep sea. It possesses enormous tentacles capable of sinking ships and has the power to control ocean currents. It has a cruel personality and is sensitive to vibrations on the surface of the sea.
E055.name: Kraken

E056.desc: A vampire demon that lurks in castles and abandoned buildings at night. It possesses high intelligence and the power of charm, and moves like a shadow. Its personality is calm and cunning. It has a variety of attack methods.
E056.name: Vampire

E057.desc: A legendary monster that inhabits mountains and volcanoes. Possessing tough scales and massive wings, it is one of the strongest creatures, with claws, a tail, and breath attacks all in one. It has a proud personality and shows no mercy to intruders.
E057.name: Dragon

E058.desc: A spirit sealed within an ancient magical artifact. It appears when the lamp is rubbed and wields immense magical power. Its personality is capricious, and it sometimes acts in a way that tests humans.
E058.name: Demon

E059.desc: An ancient species far surpassing ordinary dragons. It possesses power capable of shaking continents, and can cause storms simply by flying. Its personality is arrogant, almost godlike.
E059.name: Great Dragon

E060.desc: A monster close to a deity of the deep sea. It takes the form of a giant fish-man and rules over the underwater city. It has a cruel personality and sees humans only as prey.
E060.name: Dagon
